data: Navigation to the Pension Credit additional amount for people who are severely disabled. The captured guidance identifies separate no-partner and partner branches in DMG 78034 and 78045. The permanent-care-home paragraph 78088 is headed Claimants who have no partner (including self-funders) and requires all its conditions to be satisfied. This additional amount is distinct from the Severe Disablement Allowance benefit described in DMG 57001. This overview does not set out the full qualifying conditions or a consolidated current-law rule.
